note: Custom DESIGN boss fixture; unbalanced pending playtest. Not an SKT giant, no registry scaling, no story canon.

floors.name: The Brass Gallery
floors.posture: The castellan guards the extraction stair.
floors.motive: Hold the gallery until the challengers withdraw.
floors.law: The castellan yields when its remaining strength falls below one fifth.
floors.terrain: A broad gallery with room to fly and an open extraction stair.
floors.tell: A silver cloak overlays brass plate. The ward glows once before it breaks; four amber beads power extra spear attacks.
floors.secret: The ward stops one breaking hit; separate attacks exhaust it.

rooms.title: The Brass Castellan
rooms.tell: The returning spear threatens flyers. Plate, ring, and cloak stack to AC 23. Four amber beads buy four extra attacks.

actors.name: Brass Castellan
actors.trait: Returning spear, layered armor, a single breaking ward, and four amber follow-up charges.

equipment.name: Castellan's Returning Spear
equipment.flavor: A long brass spear returns after each throw; its etched range marks remain visible.

equipment.name: Reinforced Brass Plate
equipment.flavor: Heavy brass plates form the base defense.

equipment.name: Ring of Layered Guard
equipment.flavor: Two nested bands reinforce the plate.

equipment.name: Silver Guard Cloak
equipment.flavor: Silver wire adds the final layer of protection.
